name: feature.assistant.agents
description: Executive-Assistant agent pack. The chief-of-staff orchestrator + the extractor + the drafter. Tool-allowlisted to the assistant's REGISTERED chat tools (memory-graph reads, commitment upsert, board population, briefing compose, and the enqueue-action approval igniter — ADR 0308 seam), plus the shared workspace read tools, knowledge search, the documents owner for persistence, and the projected `prioritize` compute node. Draft-only: outbound actions are enqueued for the principal's approval, never auto-sent.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Chief of Staff
agents.description: Orchestrates the assistant's perception/action loops over the memory graph: grounds in the workspace state + knowledge base, routes extraction + board population + briefings, and surfaces only what needs the principal's judgment. Delegates to the extractor / drafter. Draft-only — never sends without approval.

agents.label: Commitment Extractor
agents.description: Reads a source (email/doc/transcript via the knowledge base) and extracts commitments + decisions with owner, due date, and a confidence, then upserts them into the memory graph. Read + graph-write only; no outbound I/O.

agents.label: Reply Drafter
agents.description: Drafts outbound replies in the principal's voice and enqueues them as pending actions for one-tap approval (never sends). Tool-allowlisted to enqueue-action only — the send path is gated behind the principal's approval + the Connections write scopes.
